peers.name: image-to-ui
peers.description: Recreate an image, screenshot, or mockup as a 1:1 UI implementation. Match the reference rather than redesigning it, then render and compare the result to correct visible differences.

en.tagline: Build and improve UI/UX in your existing project
en.summary: uizze-ui is an agent skill for building and improving UI and UX in a project you already have. It works from your code, assets and reference images, and can pull design systems, app examples, licensed fonts, icons and animation resources from uizze.com. It helps you change a screen without guessing at layout, states or licensing.
problem: When you change a screen, the layout, hierarchy and states are often guessed, and the fonts and icons may have unclear licenses. The work then needs a lot of manual checking.

With this skill, the agent reads the relevant screen, components and tokens first, then makes the change and runs the result at relevant sizes. Uizze references are used when they are available, and the final report lists the sources and checks that were actually done.
fit: Improving an existing screen while keeping its current behavior
Finding layout or design system references from real apps
Adding licensed fonts or icons with their license notices kept
Adding loading, empty, error and success states to existing UI
unfit: Projects that need backend behavior invented to make a UI work
Haptic feedback when no verified Uizze haptics resource exists
steps: The agent inspects the relevant screen, components, tokens and data contracts, and identifies the primary task.
It improves layout, hierarchy, typography and spacing, and adds requested controls and applicable states without inventing backend behavior.
It runs the result at relevant sizes and checks keyboard access, focus and overflow.
When Uizze access is available, it searches design packs, screen references, licensed fonts, icons or animated icons and applies the chosen ones to the project.
It reports the Uizze sources it actually used and the verification it actually performed.

zh.tagline: 在现有项目中构建和改进 UI/UX
zh.summary: uizze-ui 是一个面向智能体的技能，用于在你已有的项目中构建和改进 UI 与 UX。它基于你的代码、素材和参考图工作，也可以从 uizze.com 获取设计系统、真实应用示例、有授权的字体、图标以及动效资源。它帮助你在不猜测布局、状态和授权的情况下修改界面。
problem: 修改页面时，布局、层级和状态往往要靠猜，字体和图标的授权也可能不清楚，之后还需要大量人工检查。
使用这个技能后，智能体会先读取相关页面、组件和设计令牌，再进行修改，并在相关尺寸下运行检查。有可用的 Uizze 参考时会一并使用，最终报告会列出实际用到的来源和实际完成的检查。
fit: 在保留现有行为的前提下改进已有页面
从真实应用中查找布局或设计系统参考
添加有授权的字体或图标，并保留授权说明
为已有界面补充加载、空状态、错误和成功状态
unfit: 需要凭空编造后端行为才能让界面工作的项目
没有已验证的 Uizze 触觉反馈资源时，需要触觉反馈的场景
steps: 智能体检查相关页面、组件、设计令牌和数据契约，并确定主要任务。
它改进布局、层级、字体排版和间距，并补充所需控件和适用的状态，不编造后端行为。
它在相关尺寸下运行结果，检查键盘访问、焦点和内容溢出。
当可以访问 Uizze 时，它搜索设计包、页面参考、有授权的字体、图标或动态图标，并将所选内容应用到项目中。
它报告实际使用的 Uizze 来源，以及实际完成的验证。
